Name: Modular Zen Gardens Furniture
Author: Leroymilo
Description:
[size=5]This is a mod adding a new set of furniture to the game : Zen Gardens![/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]The base sprites for the Zen Garden base were inspired and made from the Obelisks sprites by SonreirAngel from Seasonal Japanese Buildings. To access this new set of Furniture, you'll need to buy the Zen Garden Catalogue at Robin's shop for 2000G.
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=5]They are modular, which means that they will connect when they touch.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]You can make your Garden any shape, it can be as big as you want! Even the Zen Garden Catalog connects with the other Gardens!
If you see this texture ->[size=3][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leroymilo/MZG/main/ModularZenGarden/assets/borders/error.png[/img] [/size]in your Garden, please send a screenshot of the shape you made so that I can fix the bug.
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=5]Now compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704]Seasonal Japanese Buildings mod[/url][/size][size=5]![/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]Simply install both mods to see your Seasonal Japanese Obelisks connect to your Zen Garden Furniture.[/size][size=4]

[/size][size=5]You can add you own Zen Garden elements.[/size]
[size=3][url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/MZG/blob/main/ArtTutorial.md]Here[/url] is a tutorial on how to add your own sprites to create new Zen Garden parts to include on your farm. If you send me the sprites you made, I can also add them [size=3](as well as your username for credit) [/size]to the mod so that other people can use them![/size]
